purpose: Hidden monitor grid: re-arranged another way (one 5-6 circuit out, a heavier load at bus 10, different dispatch and voltage schedule). Held-out runs only. Nothing selects on it and neither the solver nor the RSI updater sees it; it is scored privately to show whether gains on grid B carry over to a grid nobody tuned on.

case.name: grid_M
case.description: Kundur two-area re-arranged another way: device in GENROU 3's slot; all three 7-8 tie circuits in service; one of the two 5-6 circuits (Line_1) out; PQ_2 at bus 10 doubled to 300 MW; bus-7 load 1000 MW, bus-8 load 1150 MW; GENROU 2 at 500 MW and GENROU 4 at 650 MW; device at 650 MW with a 1.01 pu voltage schedule

device_under_test.params_note: ANDES inputs from medium_kundur_regf1/holdout/answer_key.json (seed 0): six parameters scaled by U[0.7, 1.3]; wdrp and Qdrp are converter-base droops x Sb/Sn (ANDES applies them to system-base P and Q); KPv = 6 for damping of the 0.85 Hz mode. The same device sits in every grid.

design_notes: The runs are the same three kinds as grid B's (a voltage-reference step, a load change, a line opening) but in other places, directions and sizes, on a different arrangement at a similar strength, so a real improvement should show on both grids.

Damping decided the operating point. The first draft (680 MW, 0.99 pu schedule) left the true device with a 0.93 Hz mode at a damping ratio of 0.009, and its voltage-reference run swung V between 0.84 and 1.15 pu. At 650 MW and 1.01 pu the least-damped mode is 0.92 Hz at 0.056, next to grid A's 0.058 (0.59 Hz, op1) and grid B's 0.079 (0.53 Hz), from ANDES EIG with the true device in the slot.
Damping falls as the voltage drops, so the voltage-reference step goes down only 1.5%: at -2.5% the lowered setpoint sat in a less damped region and the 0.9 Hz swing barely decayed for 12 s.

The line opening is a 6-7 circuit. Opening a 9-10 circuit moved the device's P by an RMSE of only 0.0019 pu, under the scorer's 3-sigma floor (0.003), so a flat model scored 0.97 instead of 1. The 6-7 circuit moves P and Q by 0.021 and 0.037 (B_line: 0.016 and 0.069).

Deliberately wrong models cost within about 25% of what they cost on grid B, except a 30% low KPv, which saturates two of M's three runs (1.04 against 0.53 on B; grid A's held-out runs saturate too). See monitor_check.json.
